description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and four different types of code-related resources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” is linear and spans from 200 to 800 tokens, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 200. The y-axis is linear and ranges from 10 to 40, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 10. The blue line with circle markers represents Tutorials, starting at approximately 23 and rising to about 29. The red line with circle markers represents Library Documentation, beginning at approximately 26, rising to about 30, and then declining slightly to about 27. The green line with circle markers represents Github files, starting at approximately 28, rising to about 31, and then declining slightly to about 30. The yellow line with circle markers represents StackOverflow posts, beginning at approximately 33, declining steadily to about 12.
